name: CarbonSight
tagline: Agents that pick the most energy-efficient model for each LLM request and show companies the carbon cost.

awards: MLH - Best use of Gemini API

problem: Enterprises cannot see how much energy and carbon their LLM usage costs.
solution: A parent-and-child agent structure with embeddings routes each request to the most efficient adequate model and visualises the energy network.
demo_moment: Team-described: send prompts and see the green model chosen and the footprint saved.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “MLH - Best use of Gemini API” among 85 submissions.
Makes AI's own footprint visible and actionable.

lessons: AI-for-AI-efficiency is a sponsor-friendly sustainability angle.
